title: Spent $2k+ on claude credits in just a few weeks to build my AI game
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Yes, it's true but I'm iterating super fast at the moment working on a fully AI native online game similar to gta online but in habbo hotel style and all content is live AI generated!   
Players can create own characters, weapons, buildings in the shared universe and raid others players homes! 

If you are interested, you can join the discord to try the first demo: [https://discord.gg/BFqQZHhkv6](https://discord.gg/BFqQZHhkv6)

Okay, so I spent the tokens on the development of the tech behind the game. I develop it in Unity and also have my own Server System for the Servers. 

If you a curious about the result you can try it on pc or iPhone (links in the discord) or Watch the Trailer on steam but it’s a quite outdated.

And Unity also either just came out with or is coming out with an AI version with their own AI or plug your own in with their MCP. And yeah, just pay for a maxed subscription or a few cheaper ones and just switch your account as needed when one rate limit runs out.   
Also are you using skills or scripts for a lot of repetitive tasks so you’re not unwittingly loading the whole codebase into the context window every time you ask a question or give it a task.
